checks.source: Participants and ethics statement (sixteen stroke patients)
Participants and ethics statement (nine healthy control participants)
Methods, Experiment 2 (blocks of 96 movements, 12 in each of the 8 directions)

checks.what: rows = 25 participants x 2 arms x 5 blocks x 96

differences: Experiment 1 (resting postural forces while the robot holds the hand at about 54 positions, F_P_DT file) and the hold-perturbation (release) data of Experiment 2 are not converted; neither is the 763 MB trajectory file. The force-pulse trials of Experiment 2 are kept with their pulse direction in trial_measures.csv (trial_pulse_pert: 1 counter-clockwise, -1 clockwise, 0 none; the paper describes a 12 N, 70 ms pulse after 2 cm of movement).

The deposit does not say which of the five blocks per arm is the familiarization block. The authors' analysis code uses blocks 1 to 4 and leaves block 5 out of their rejection step, and block 5 has the slowest movements, so block 5 is treated as the familiarization block (phase practice, placed first in each arm's sequence). The order of blocks 1 to 4 is the file's. This is inferred.

The authors' rule rejects reaches whose angle at 150 ms is more than 90 degrees from the target (blocks 1 to 4); these are marked in excluded_by_authors. Their other exclusions (stabilization during holds) concern the hold data.
Ages are given only as 5-year ranges per patient in the paper and are not in the deposit, so no age column is included.

The paper's mean time to target (1.59 s patients' paretic side, 0.82 s controls) was not reproduced exactly: unperturbed outward reaches of the paretic (or primary) arm in blocks 1 to 4, without the angle-rejected reaches, give 1.61 s and 0.84 s. The authors' exact selection of reaches is not in the deposit, so these two checks were dropped.

The paper's mean path to target (13.4 cm patients' paretic side, 10.8 cm controls) was not reproduced to its printed rounding: the same selection of reaches gives 13.3 cm and 10.9 cm (p_whole_mvt x 100). The two checks were dropped.
